entities.summary: Fan service , fanservice or service cut  is material in a work of fiction or in a fictional series that is intentionally added to please the audience. Classically sexual in nature, fan service may depict fictional characters in revealing outfits, poses, or situations, occasionally involving partial or full nudity. The term originated in Japanese in the anime and manga fandom.
